g.text: DIR. S. BELMIROHA · SCENE 04: MARKET CHASE · ACTION
Market crowded. He's 20 meters back. Don't lose him.
Quick cut. Hard pound on cobblestones.
Target collides with fruit stall. Detective closing.
Gap narrowing. Target looks back — fear flashes.
Pinned. Crowd murmurs return. Breathing slows.
SCENE 04 TOTAL · 0:10 · 6 SHOTS · FAST CUTS (0.7–3.0s) · COVERAGE: WIDE → INSERT → CRASH → OTS → IMPACT → RESOLUTION
